title: VEO Video Creator Output Schema
description: Output format for Veo 3.1 optimized video prompts. The LLM returns this JSON structure after processing user inputs through the skill prompt.

name.description: Character role name (e.g., Host, Guest, Narrator, Person A)

description.description: Visual description: age, build, hairstyle, wardrobe, accessories, distinguishing features

shotType.description: Camera framing used (e.g., medium close-up, two-shot, aerial wide shot)

cameraMovement.description: Camera motion applied (e.g., static, dolly in, pan left, tracking)

lighting.description: Lighting setup description (e.g., 3-point, golden hour, rim light)

depthOfField.description: Focus depth applied (e.g., shallow with soft bokeh, deep focus, rack focus)

colorPalette.description: Color grading applied (e.g., warm amber tones, teal and orange, desaturated)

mood.description: Emotional tone of the scene (e.g., warm and professional, dramatic, serene)

description.description: Shot description for this time segment

prompt.description: Complete Veo 3.1 optimized prompt following the formula: [CINEMATOGRAPHY] + [SUBJECT] + [ACTION] + [CONTEXT] + [STYLE & LIGHTING] + [AUDIO]

duration.description: Clip duration in seconds. Must be 8 for 1080p/4K/reference images.

resolution.description: Output resolution. 720p required for extension mode.

audioDescription.description: Brief summary of audio elements for UI display (e.g., Thai male host speaking, studio ambience)

characterDescriptions.description: Character details for consistency across clips. Empty array if no characters.

sceneBreakdown.description: Structured breakdown of cinematography choices made

autoCorrections.description: List of auto-corrections applied due to parameter conflicts (e.g., duration forced to 8s for 1080p). Omit if none.

extensionNotes.description: Notes for extension mode: what carries over, what to maintain. Only present when sceneMode is extension.

prompt.description: Complete Veo 3.1 prompt for this scene

timestampBlocks.description: Optional timestamp blocks for multi-shot within this scene

audioDescription.description: Brief audio summary for this scene

transitionNote.description: How this scene transitions to the next (e.g., cut to, dissolve, fade to black)

scenes.description: Array of scene prompts in sequence

aspectRatio.description: Aspect ratio applied to all scenes

style.description: Visual style applied to all scenes

characterDescriptions.description: Character details shared across all scenes for consistency

totalDuration.description: Total duration in seconds across all scenes

extensionStrategy.description: How to assemble scenes: separate clips or extension chain

examples.prompt: Medium close-up, eye-level, static tripod shot. Clean 3-point lighting with soft fill and subtle rim light on a neutral gray studio backdrop. A Thai male host, early 30s, short neat hair, wearing a casual navy blazer over a white t-shirt, warm friendly expression. Host says (Thai, warm and energetic): "Hello everyone, today we will summarize 3 techniques for making clips." He gestures naturally with his right hand while speaking. Ambient: quiet studio room tone, very subtle air conditioning hum in background.
examples.audioDescription: Thai male host speaking warmly, studio ambience

characterDescriptions.name: Host
characterDescriptions.description: Thai male, early 30s, short neat hair, navy blazer, white t-shirt, friendly

sceneBreakdown.depthOfField: shallow, neutral gray backdrop softly blurred
sceneBreakdown.colorPalette: warm amber tones, clean skin tones
